about: Repeat passes of Page images cells, kept outside vision.json's table, which holds each cell's first pass (chosen as the cell before the runs). Each repeat pass asked the cell's questions again with the same inputs and runner and was stored in a file of its own; its answers are in vision.json's form ([pick, option probabilities, right]), compared with the first pass's.
